title: Getting started
summary: Get your first Coop world running in a few minutes.

sections.heading: Before you start
steps: Install Bannerlord and the Coop mod from the Steam Workshop. The dedicated server comes with the mod.
Open Coodsz Coop Server Tool. If it cannot find the server, press Set server folder on the Dashboard.
Pick BannerlordCoopServer.exe. It is in Workshop folder 3770450698\DedicatedServer.

sections.heading: Make a world
steps: On Saves, press Create a world.
Start a fresh campaign, or continue a single player campaign from your own save.
Give the world a name and pick a difficulty.
Set the rules and a password if you want one, then press Create world.

sections.heading: Start the server
steps: Press Start server on the Dashboard.
The first time, read the server terms and press I accept.
Wait until the status says Server online. The first start can take a few minutes.
sections.tip: The world presets on Settings fill in the difficulty for you. Casual, Standard and Hardcore.

sections.heading: New in this version
steps: New things have a gold NEW badge. Click one to try it and its badge goes away.
Press What's new under the language button to see what changed in the last few versions.
The What's new window also opens by itself once after each update.
